company.name: Zigfu
company.shortDescription: Zigfu provides a gesture-controlled user experience using the Microsoft Kinect or other motion tracking sensors.
company.description: Zigfu is a software development company based in California that is best known for its Zigfu Development Kit for Kinect. The development kit allows users to create motion-controlled 3D games for the Kinect platform. Also provides a gesture-controlled portal and app store to the developers for distributing their games.

productsAndServices.description: Zigfu Development Kit is a cross-platform toolkit for building gesture-controlled applications and 3D games using Kinect and similar sensors.
productsAndServices.name: Zigfu Development Kit (ZDK)

productsAndServices.description: Zigfu Browser Plugin is a web browser extension that enables web apps to access and use connected motion sensor hardware for gesture control.
productsAndServices.name: Zigfu Browser Plugin
